# GTA2 renderer source provenance

Source: https://github.com/gebdag/gta2-rtx-remix

Pinned commit: `537c51192801fb041cd87ac7107103642be3322b`.

Copied source paths: `src`, `dll/src`, `dll/deps/imgui`, `dll/deps/bridge_api`, `vid/src`, the two DLL export definition files, and the original MIT license. Original GTA2 files, upstream packaged mods, texture replacements, screenshots and runtime binaries are not included.

Copyright (c) 2026 gebdag. See `LICENSE`. Dear ImGui includes its own MIT license; Remix API header notices remain in their original files. GTA2Ceiling changes add a CMake build, local configuration/module naming and a standalone raster/XR integration. RTX runtime loading is disabled for this project.
